en: Psalms 66
For the Chief Musician. A song. A Psalm.

p.src: 1  Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!

en: Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!
u.src: 1  Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!

p.src: 2  Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!

en: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!
u.src: 2  Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!

p.src: 3  Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.

en: Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.
u.src: 3  Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.

p.src: 4  All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.” Selah.

en: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.” Selah.
u.src: 4  All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.” Selah.

p.src: 5  Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.

en: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.
u.src: 5  Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.

p.src: 6  He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.

en: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.
u.src: 6  He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.

p.src: 7  He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don’t let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.

en: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don’t let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.
u.src: 7  He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don’t let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.

p.src: 8  Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,

en: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,
u.src: 8  Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,

p.src: 9  who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.

en: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.
u.src: 9  who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.

p.src: 10  For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.

en: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.
u.src: 10  For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.

p.src: 11  You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.

en: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.
u.src: 11  You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.

p.src: 12  You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.

en: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.
u.src: 12  You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.

p.src: 13  I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,

en: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,
u.src: 13  I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,

p.src: 14  which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.

en: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.
u.src: 14  which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.

p.src: 15  I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.

en: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.
u.src: 15  I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.

p.src: 16  Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.

en: Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.
u.src: 16  Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.

p.src: 17  I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.

en: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.
u.src: 17  I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.

p.src: 18  If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.

en: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.
u.src: 18  If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.

p.src: 19  But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.

en: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.
u.src: 19  But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.

p.src: 20  Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.

en: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.
u.src: 20  Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.
